# ATT — Attachments

- Owner: `ticonnect-daemon`
- Stage: 9
- Layer: `daemon`
- Component graph: [generated/components/att.md](generated/components/att.md)

## Purpose

Own content-addressed attachment storage, validation, chunked resumable transfer, linking, progress, and export.

## Boundary

Daemon service. Uses transport streams, storage metadata, and messaging linking. UI requests export over IPC.

## Owned state

- attachment content store
- partial transfer state

## Invariants

- `INV-ATT-1` — Attachment hash is verified before the file is published into the content store. Test: planned: crates/daemon/tests/attachments.rs
- `INV-LIMIT-1` — Every queue, buffer, and frame decoder is bounded or declares its drop policy. Test: planned: design review plus fuzz tests
- `INV-STAGE-1` — Every stage demo uses only components from that stage or earlier stages. Test: cargo xtask systems --check
- `INV-TRUST-1` — No non-pairing feature is reachable before trust is established. Test: planned: crates/net/tests/unpaired_rejected.rs

## Failure semantics

- verify hash before publish
- temp files are restrictive
- size and MIME limits
- no symlink following

## Open decisions

- chunk size and resume framing
- disk quota policy
- orphan cleanup policy
